scope: All configured territories, including previously scanned territories
priority: Smaller and owner-operated contractors, where supported by evidence
ownership_rule: Local ownership, a small website or an LLC name do not establish owner operation or employee count
source_access: Publicly accessible or publicly indexed material only; access failures remain explicit
signal_rules: Separate contractor advertisements, recommendations, business listings and request candidates
A search snippet is not a verified post, current business, owner operation or confirmed demand
Publication date must be verified from the source; crawl and retrieval dates are not publication dates
Undated, inaccessible and closure-related results require review
Whitepages is for public business discovery and corroboration, never private-person or home-address research
No automatic contact, provider acceptance, order or demand confirmation
